_note: Hand review of the generated cloze cards for the Compilation of Fundamental Rules and Supplementary Rules. `verdict` is approve, edit or reject; a rejected card stays in data/rules/cards/fr-sr.json with reviewState "rejected" and is never served. `hi` is a freshly authored Hindi cloze on the same rule, not a translation of the English excerpt — this source is a 296-page scan with no usable Hindi text layer (docs/DATA-GAPS.md #45), so every Hindi sentence here is written from scratch to test the same fact the English card tests. The blank marker ____ must appear in both stems. Terminology reuses scripts/authoring/hindi/fr-sr.json's established vocabulary (वेतन निर्धारण, वेतनवृद्धि, प्रतिनियुक्ति, अधिहक़, प्रतिपूरक भत्ता, मानदेय, विदेशी सेवा) and, for a rule number cited inline, 'नियम <n>' — mirroring cloze-ccs-conduct.json's own convention rather than restating 'F.R.' inline. This source has more OCR noise and a much longer average rule than the CCS Conduct Rules — many generated cards here are windowed excerpts of a long paragraph that end mid-clause or mid-word; a trailing cut is tolerated where the tested fact and its immediate context are already complete before the cut, and rejected where the cut falls inside the blank's own context or leaves the fact ambiguous.
